loudness.notes: EBU R128: Programme Loudness target -23.0 LUFS with a permitted deviation of ±0.5 LU where exact normalisation is possible (±1.0 LU is allowed for live material). Maximum Permitted True Peak Level -1 dBTP (measured with a ≥4x-oversampling true-peak meter). Loudness Range (LRA) is measured and reported but not gated — R128 defines no LRA ceiling.

governance.source: EBU R 128 — Loudness normalisation and permitted maximum level of audio signals
governance.notes: Audio-only delivery profile: checks EBU R128 integrated loudness and true-peak on a standalone audio file (no video). Carries no video, container, codec, channel-layout or timed-text constraints — loudness compliance only. Loudness/true-peak are measured by the C++ audioqc engine (SQC-1365) via the audio slow-tier fan-out (SQC-1571).
